t: Tiltul al yede dabar acher im muttar beshabbat
s: Tiltul al yede dabar acher im muttar beshabbat ubo y"a seipim: notel adam et beno birshut hayyachid vehaeben beyado, veeno chashub kimtaltel et haeben beyadayv. Vehu shei epshar beinyan acher, kegon sheyyesh libno gaaguin alayv, sheim lo yittelennu yecheleh, velo gazeru al tiltul shello beyadayim mammash bimqom sakkanat choli. Vegam i epshar lehashlik haeben miyyad hattinoq, mippene sheyyitzaq veyibkeh. Abal im en lo gaaguin alayv — asur littelo. Veeno domeh lishar tiltul dabar haasur shemmittaltel meelayv al yede shemmetaltel beyado et haddabar hammuttar sheimmo, shehittiru chakamim keshei epshar lenaer haissur min hahetter kemo sheyyitbaer, lepi shello hittiru ken ella keshetztzarik ledabar hammuttar, abal kan en zeh tzorek kol kak littol et hattinoq kesheen lo gaaguin alayv:

Vaapillu kesheyyesh lo gaaguin alayv lo hittiru ella beeben, abal im dinar beyado — asur apillu leechoz beyado vehu mehallek beraglayv birshut hayyachid, gezera shemma yippol haddinar miyyado veyishkach abiv veyagbihennu, venimtza metaltel muqtzeh tiltul gamur, uletiltul gamur chasheshu vegazeru apillu bimqom sakkanat choli, kevan sheen sham sakkanat nepesh im lo yittelennu:

Kalkala shehayeta nequba usetamah beeben mibbeod yom (im hiddeqah sham bechozeq) — muttar letaltelah, shello naaset basis ledabar haasur, lepi sheap haeben naasa keli (keshehu mehuddaq bah), shehare naasa kedopnah. Veken delaat chalula shettolin bah eben lehakbidah lemallot bah mayim, im haeben qashur bah yapeh mibbeod yom, sheeno nopel mimmenna keshemmemalleim bah — muttar lemallot bah, lepi sheap haeben huttar betiltul, mippene shennaasa kemo haddelaat atzmah shehu batel etzlah. Veim lav — asur lemallot bah, ella im ken yiched eben zeh lekak leolam, kemo shennitbaer leel besimman sh"ch:

Dabar haasur betiltul shemmunnach al dabar hammuttar, im hinnicho alayv mibbeod yom middato al daat sheyyishshaer munnach sham gam beshabbat — hare naasa hahetter basis lehaissur, veneesar betiltul kamohu mammash. Abal im lo haya bedato sheyyishshaer munnach sham beshabbat veshakach lahasiro mimmennu qodem kenisat hashshabbat, shello naasa basis elayv. Veken im naasa basis leissur ulehetter, kegon shehinniach alayv mibbeod yom gam dabar hammuttar betiltul shechashub yoter middabar haasur kemo sheyyitbaer besimman sh"y, kevan shello naasa basis leissur bilbaddo — hare hu omed adayin behettero, umuttar letaltelo ap sheggam haissur shealayv mittaltel immo meelayv. Ella sheim epshar lenaer haissur mimmennu miyyad — tzarik lenaaro mittechilla, veachar kak yetaltel hahetter bilbad lemaqom shetztzarik elayv. Veim i epshar lenaer, o sheyyihyeh ezeh hepsed bedabar hammuttar im yenaer et haissur, o shello yaspiq lo hanniur lehashlim bo hatztzorek shehu tzarik letiltul zeh, kegon shemmetaltel hahetter im haissur shealayv lemaqom acher mippene shetztzarik lepannot meqomam zeh shehem alayv akshav kede lehishtammesh bo ezeh tashmish o tzorek acher beinyan sheim yenaer kan haissur lo yukal lehashlim tzorko bammaqom hazzeh — muttar letaltel hahetter im haissur shealayv:

Ketzad? Kalkala melea perot vehaeben betokah, ap al pi shehinnicho sham mibbeod yom bemitkavven sheyyishshaer sham beshabbat, kevan sheyyesh perot bekalkala — hare naaset basis leissur ulehetter, velo neesra betiltul. Velaken im hem perot retubbim verakkim meod, kegon teenim vaanabim, sheim yenaaren yittannepu baqqarqa veyippasedu — muttar littol hakkalkala kemot shehi im happerot vehaeben shebbetokah uleholikah lemaqom shetztzerikim lo happerot leoklam sham. Veen mechayyebim oto littol happerot beyadayv uleholikam, ki shemma yippelu miyyadayv laaretz veyittannepu. Veim hem munnachim besallim qetannim tok hakkalkala — yittol hassallim beyado mittok hakkalkala veyolikem echad echad beinyan sheen chashash sheyyippelu happerot laaretz. Veim tzarik littol gup hakkalkala lemaqom acher kede lehishtammesh bah sham ezeh tashmish — yittol hassallim mittokah beyado veyannichem al gabbe qarqa, veachar kak yenaer haeben mittokah veyittelenna. Veim hem perot yebeshim sheenam nipsadim keshehem mittannepim baqqarqa ap sheenam besallim — lo yittol hakkalkala kemot shehi im happerot vehaeben, ben shetztzarik lapperot ben shetztzarik lakkalkala, ella yenaarem mittokah im haeben, veachar kak yelaqqetem beyado veyachazirem lakkalkala im yirtzeh. Abal im tzarik limqom hakkalkala beinyan shello yaspiq lo hanniur — muttar lo littelah mikkan kemot shehi bekol inyan:

Veken im hinniach eben al pi chabit shel yayin lekissuy veshakach lahasirah mishsham qodem hashshabbat, o shehinniach maot al hakkar veshakach littelam mealeha qodem hashshabbat, vehu tzarik littol yayin min hechabit o lishkab al hakkar, kevan shehechabit vehakkar lo naasu basis ledabar haasur — hare hu matteh hechabit al tziddah vehaeben nopelet, umenaer et hakkar vehammaot nopelim. Veim hayeta hechabit ben hechabiyyot beinyan sheeno yakol lehattotah bimqomah — yakol lehagbihah kemot shehi im haeben shealeha ulenosah lemaqom acher lehattotah sham kede lehappil haeben mealeha. Veim tzarik limqom hechabit vehakkar beinyan sheen hanniur maspiq lo — yakol letaltelan kemot shehen im haeben vehammaot shealehen kede lippanot meqoman. Veim eno tzarik lo legup hakkar velo limqomah, ella shechoshesh shello yigganebu hammaot shealeha — asur apillu lenaarah kede sheyyippelu hammaot tachteha, mippene shello hittiru tiltul al yede dabar acher ella keshemmetaltel bishbil dabar hammuttar, velo bishbil dabar haasur, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shy"a:

Vekol zeh beshokeach, abal im hinnicham sham middato al daat sheyyishshaaru sham gam beshabbat, ben shetztzarik limqom hechabit vehakkar, ben shetztzarik legupan, littol hayyayin min hechabit velishkab al hakkar — asur apillu lehattotan ulenaaran, lepi shekkevan shennaasu basis leissur — naasu issur kamohu, veasur letaltelan kelal apillu behattaya veniur bilbad kemo haissur atzmo. Vaapillu im haya bedato shello yishshaaru sham kol hashshabbat kullah ella biknisat hashshabbat bilbad, dehaynu shehaya bedato sheyyishshaaru sham ad leachar ben hashshemashot bilbad, sheaz yesirem mishsham al yede niur — en zeh moil kelum lehattir lo apillu hanniur shehaya dato alayv, lepi shemmittok shennaasu hechabit vehakkar basis leissur beben hashshemashot shehu techillat kenisat hashshabbat — huqtzu lekol hashshabbat kullah, veen dato moelet lehattiram. Veyesh omerim shello naasu basis leissur ella im ken haya bedato sheyyishshaaru sham haeben vehammaot kol hashshabbat kullah, abal im haya bedato littelam mishsham beemtza hashshabbat, ben al yede nokri ben al yede niur — lo naasu kelal hechabit vehakkar basis lahem apillu bitchillat kenisat hashshabbat, velo neesru kelal betiltul, velo huqtzu lekol hashshabbat kullah. Velaken im nimlak apillu bitchillat kenisat hashshabbat lehattot hechabit ulenaer hakkar, im hutzrak legupan, o letaltelan kemo shehen im haeben vehammaot shealehen im hutzrak limqoman — hare zeh muttar kemo beshokeach. Abal im lo haya bedato littol haeben vehammaot mehechabit vehakkar al yede niur o al yede nokri, ella haya bedato letaltel beemtza hashshabbat et hechabit vehakkar im haeben vehammaot shealehen lemaqom acher al yede nokri o al yede yisrael kesheyyitztarek limqoman — en zeh moil kelum, kevan sheap beoto maqom yihyeh haeben vehammaot munnachim alehem — hare hen basis lahem. Vehaiqqar kisbara harishona. Umikkol maqom, bimqom hepsed yesh lismok al sebara haacharona, kegon im napal ner al hashshulchan, kemo shennitbaer besimman ra"z:

Uledibre hakkol, im hu beinyan shennaasu basis leissur beben hashshemashot, ap im achar kak nittal haissur mealehen — asur letaltelan kol hashshabbat kullah kemo keshehaya haissur alehen, shemmittok shehuqtzu ben hashshemashot — huqtzu lekol hashshabbat kullah, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman sh"y:

En hahetter naaseh basis leissur ella im ken hinnicho alayv bekavvana leezeh tzorek, ben letzorek haissur atzmo, bishbil sheyyityashsheb alayv betob, kegon maot sheal hakkar, ben letzorek dabar acher hammuttar, kegon eben sheal pi hechabit. Abal im hinnicho alayv bederek aqray, shello bekavvana leezeh tzorek shetztzarik lo sheyyihyeh munnach alayv, ella kemo shergilin lehasim beteba chapatzim ellu al ellu mippene sheen lo revach lepannot maqom lekol chepetz beshule hatteba — lo naasa zeh basis lazeh, vedino keshokeach. Velaken muttar letaltel hammappa sheal hashshulchan ap al pi shehammenora omedet aleha, lepi sheeno tzarik lo shettehe hammenora al hammappa ella al hashshulchan, veeno maamidah al hammappa ella mippene shei epshar lo lepannot maqom lehammenora begup hashshulchan atzmo, o mippene sheeno choshesh lepannot lah maqom, ulepikak lo naaset hammappa basis lehammenora, velo neesra betiltul:

Qinna shel tarnegolim sheyyesh bah betza sheyyesh bah eproach, shebbetza zo asura betiltul mippene sheenah reuya ap lekeleb mechamat qelippatah — hare haqqinna naasa basis lehabbetza, shekkevan shehaqqinna asuya lattarnegolin — en zeh keshokeach ella kemanniach middaat. Veken kol kayyotze bazeh:

Im adam hinniach debar muqtzeh al dabar hammuttar shel chabero shello middato, ap im gam dabar hammuqtzeh hu shel chabero — lo naasa hahetter basis lehaissur, lepi sheen adam oser chepetz shel chabero shello middato. Veim asa ken letobat chabero, shemmin hassetam noach lachabero dabar zeh sheasa letobato, kegon shennatal reuben keli cheres shel shimon veheemido mibbeod yom tachat hanner bebet shimon kede sheyyippol hanner letoko velo yissarep habbayit, venapal hanner letoko qodem ben hashshemashot vehaya betoko ad achar ben hashshemashot — naasa hakkeli basis lehanner, veasur letaltelo kol hashshabbat kullah. Veken kol kayyotze bazeh:
